extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.intro: Extensions are small programs that run next to Meshloom, each in its own isolated process, and only do what you allow them to do.
extensions.empty: No extension installed yet. Add a bundled extension to get started.

enableBlocked.review: Open it to review and accept

explain.bwrap: Each extension runs in a sandbox that sees only its own code, no other file of this server.
explain.setuid: Each extension runs under a dedicated system account that cannot read Meshloom's files.
explain.none: No operating-system isolation is available here: Meshloom's own rules stop honest mistakes but do not stop a hostile extension, which could read the database and files. Only install extensions you trust.
explain.unknown: The isolation level is reported once the server has started the extension system.

purgeBlocked.title: A temporary folder keeps extension accounts taken
purgeBlocked.text: When an extension is removed, Meshloom cleans up what its account left in the temporary folders before giving the account to another extension. It could not look inside these folders, so the accounts stay taken (nothing is lost, it is a safety rule):
purgeBlocked.fix: On the server, remove these folders or make them readable (chmod o+r), then restart Meshloom.
purgeBlocked.leaseFix: A path in .meshloom-plugin-uids is a reservation: another Meshloom on this machine (another container, for example) holds that account, so this one leaves it alone. Remove that file only if no other Meshloom runs here any more, then restart Meshloom. A file whose folder is not owned by Meshloom, or can be written by others, must be removed too.

disabled.env: Extensions are turned off by the host of this server. You can look at them and uninstall them, but not change or start them.
disabled.platform: Extensions are not available on this platform. You can look at them and uninstall them, but not change or start them.
disabled.isolation: Extensions are off because the isolation they need could not be set up. You can look at them and uninstall them, but not change or start them.
disabled.drawer: Extensions are turned off on this server: nothing here can be changed or started.

migration.text: Review each converted extension before starting it: it only runs once you have accepted what it may do.

migration.bannerText_other: {{count}} bots were converted into extensions and stay off until you review their permissions.

extensions.memberReadOnly: Only an administrator can add, change, start, remove or pause extensions. You can see what is installed and how it is doing.
extensions.drawerMemberReadOnly: Only an administrator can change, restart or uninstall this extension, or read its log.

pause.hint: The incident switch: stops every extension at once and starts none until you resume. Each extension keeps its own on/off setting.
pause.confirmText: Every running extension stops now and none starts, even after a restart of Meshloom, until an administrator resumes them. Messages received meanwhile are not handed to them later. Each extension keeps its own on/off setting.
pause.banner: All extensions are paused since {{time}} by {{user}}.
pause.bannerUnreadable: All extensions are held paused because the pause state could not be read. They stay stopped until an administrator resumes them.
pause.bannerExplain: None runs and none receives messages. Changes are saved and apply on resume.

store.title: Custom repositories
store.intro: Add a plugin published on GitHub as owner/name. Its latest release must carry manifest.json, plugin.zip and plugin.zip.sha256.
store.warning: Custom repositories are not reviewed or signed by Meshloom: you install them at your own risk. The plugin.zip.sha256 file comes from the same place as the archive, so it only checks that the download is intact (integrity), not who made it. There is no online revocation for these plugins.
store.offline: The Store is offline: nothing is fetched from GitHub until you put it online.
store.removeIntro: Installed plugins from this repository stay installed and keep working; they will no longer be checked for updates.
store.accept: I understand this plugin is not reviewed or signed by Meshloom, and I accept these permissions.
store.adminOnly: Only an administrator can see and manage custom repositories.
